# herma

herma is a shared, reviewed memory for coding agents: the principles a person
approves about how agents should work, and reviewed knowledge about each
project. It is one Go binary and one SQLite file. Source and documentation:
https://github.com/moncho/herma

You are an agent setting herma up for the person you are working with. Follow
these steps in order, and stop to ask whenever a step would change something
they did not ask for.

## 1. Check whether herma is already installed

```sh
herma version
```

If that prints a version, skip to step 3.

## 2. Install the binary

With Go 1.27 or later:

```sh
go install github.com/moncho/herma/cmd/herma@latest
```

Without Go, download the release archive for this machine from
https://github.com/moncho/herma/releases/latest, unpack it, and put `herma` on
the PATH. Ask before writing outside the person's home folder.

## 3. Ask which setup they want

- A new herma on this machine: continue with step 4.
- Joining a herma server that already runs elsewhere: they need its URL and an
  agent token from whoever runs it. Do not run `herma init`. Follow
  "Remote access" in
  https://github.com/moncho/herma/blob/main/docs/operations.md instead.

## 4. Initialize and start the service

```sh
herma init      # creates `owner` (the reviewer) and `local-agent` in ~/.config/herma
herma serve     # keep this running in its own terminal
```

`herma init` does not overwrite existing credentials. Never read, print or use
the reviewer's token: reviewing is the person's job, not yours.

## 5. Load principles into every session

```sh
herma hook install --client both   # or claude, or codex
```

This edits the person's Claude Code and Codex configuration, so confirm with
them first.

## 6. Bind this repository (optional)

From the repository root, to give its sessions their own principles and index:

```sh
herma create --kind project --title 'My repository' --status active
herma project bind --project PROJECT_ID
```

## 7. Hand over

Tell the person what you installed and changed, and that proposals wait for
them: `herma review` lists them and prints the command that accepts each one.

More detail:

- Setup: https://github.com/moncho/herma/blob/main/docs/setup.md
- Usage: https://github.com/moncho/herma/blob/main/docs/usage.md
- Operations: https://github.com/moncho/herma/blob/main/docs/operations.md
